content.text: Section 11 fully covers the rule at the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets the preferred position in full: 11.1 gives up to six months of transition assistance on termination for any reason at the expiring Order Form rates (rates no higher than then-current, which favours us), including knowledge transfer, migration and cooperation with a replacement supplier; 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented machine-readable format with metadata, and bars withholding data over a fee dispute; and 11.3 requires secure deletion after confirmed return with written certification by an authorized officer, with any law-required retained copy remaining protected. Section 16.5 expressly defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15, and Sections 10.1–10.2 preserve access through the transition period and Deliverable/refund rights, so there is no conflicting immediate-deletion or data-hostage term. Deletion is keyed to Customer's confirmation of successful return rather than a fixed 30-day trigger, which is a timing nuance in our favour and not a deviation.
